ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (25) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form); blocks 2, 3 had no website counterpart and were translated fresh.

«Совершенствование» (sovershenstvovaniye) is 'perfecting' and «совершенствуешься» (sovershenstvuyeshsya) 'you are perfecting yourself', while «улучшение» (uluchsheniye) is 'improvement'; generic «человек» (chelovek, 'person') keeps 'he'. The opening two sentences, absent from the website draft, are translated fresh, and attributions follow the print (John Ruskin, Lucy Mallory, Amiel).

Source observation: [5] «способны питать» ('capable of nourishing') may be a slip for «питаться» (pitat'sya, 'to be nourished'), which matches Ruskin's 'capable of nourishment'; translated as printed.
